rounds.text: HRS Aluglaze demonstrates exceptional fundamental outperformance, underpinned by a compounded sales growth rate of 44% over 3 years and an acceleration to 60% over the trailing twelve months [E11, E12]. This top-line momentum directly translates to profitability, evidenced by compounded profit growth of 127% over 3 years and 98% over the trailing twelve months [E13, E14]. Operational efficiency has scaled dramatically, with the operating margin expanding by 19 percentage points over three years to reach 27% by March 2026, supported by a consistent multi-year upward trend [E17, E18, E42]. Furthermore, the company's return profile significantly outpaces the broader sector: its return on equity reaches up to 21.4% with a 3-year median of 24%, comfortably exceeding the sector benchmark of 9.17% [E7, E10, E15], while its ROCE of up to 18.9% similarly bests the 10.83% sector benchmark [E8]. Conceded: the business maintains negative operating and free cash flows alongside a zero dividend yield [E4, E21, E22], reflecting near-term working capital headwinds [E37]. Nevertheless, this non-cyclical business [E35] continues to generate robust profit and sales growth [E39, E40] that vastly outpace sector medians [E46, E47], validating its strong operating leverage and underlying market demand.
